Title: Why You Keep Getting Indigestion After Fast Meals - And How To Fix It

Description:
After a big or fast meal, your stomach's ability to relax and stretch to hold that food can get overwhelmed — research shows this shows up in up to half of people with recurring stomach discomfort, and up to a third also have food sitting in the stomach longer than normal.

Eating fast makes it worse, since your brain needs time to register that you're full. Once indigestion hits, a short walk helps move food through your stomach, and staying upright for at least 3 hours before lying down keeps stomach acid from creeping back up.

Ginger tea, peppermint tea, and an OTC antacid can all help too — just watch out, peppermint can worsen heartburn for some people.

If indigestion keeps coming back for weeks, or comes with weight loss, vomiting, or black stools, see a doctor to rule out something else going on.
